text:
nate: quick heads-up — ran into onboarding friction yesterday. Docs say REDWOOD_API_KEY but our sampleapps also accept REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE and REDWOOD_ORG. folks keep asking which to set.

jess: can you summarize the user pain?

nate: TL;DR: when users rotate keys they try `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` which works for one-off CLI calls but breaks services that expect an atomic token file. no clear guidance in sampleapp README.

caroline: annoying. we also have SDK parity gaps: go/node lazy-read env, python eager-read on import. that surprises teams running long-lived workers.

nate: repro snippet I shared in the onboarding issue:
```
# rotating via atomic file swap recommended for daemons
echo newtoken > /tmp/new && mv /tmp/new ~/.config/redwood/token && systemctl reload rw-worker
```

jess: addition: add `rw auth stash` to write token atomically and `rw auth reload` to signal processes. makes ops life easier.

caroline: agreed. SDK changes: 1) unify env var precedence docs: REDWOOD_API_KEY (env) > REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE (path) > ~/.config/redwood/token > runtime cache. 2) change python SDK to lazy-read with short TTL (4s) to match node/go. 3) for streaming endpoints: on 401/403, re-read sources once and attempt a single resume.

nate: can we also emit a clear telemetry event when reauth happens? e.g., auth.reloads, auth.failures so support can correlate user pain with rotation events.

jess: yes. add metrics and a small debug log line: "auth: reloaded token from REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE". helps debugging.

dev-bot: created issue RBW-4012 (labels: devex, sdk, onboarding)

caroline: server-side: can we standardize on a hint header when we revoke a key? propose `X-Reauth-Required: 1` plus `Retry-After: 2` for immediate revokes. also include `WWW-Authenticate: Redwood realm=\"api\", error=\"expired_token\"` for clarity.

nate: that will help clients avoid guessing. clients can treat that header as signal to re-read creds immediately and attempt resume.

jess: implementation plan: CLI helper + sampleapp README update + python SDK PR to lazy-read + unit tests simulating atomic token swap + add metric events. I'll own the CLI + docs. caroline can own python PR.

caroline: will also add a short section in onboarding: "Rotating keys for services" with examples for systemd, k8s (use secret update with rolling restart) and container entrypoint patterns.

nate: tiny UX ask: make REDWOOD_TOKEN_FILE path discoverable via `rw auth status` so users know where to rotate.

jess: good call. `rw auth status` will print effective sources and precedence.

dev-bot: linked PRs placeholder: #4251 (cli/docs), #4252 (python-sdk).

nate: thanks team — this should reduce a bunch of support noise during onboarding. :thumbsup:
